name: Position and Effect
use_when: Use when every risky action should say up front how bad a miss gets and how much a hit achieves (heists, capers, tense missions).

controlled: a real setback, but on your terms: back off, or try again from risky
it does not work: back off, or try again from risky
it works, with a small cost: a little less done, or a minor snag
it works better than planned: more done, and something extra
risky: it goes wrong and it gets worse: harm, and the position turns desperate
it goes wrong: harm, a complication, or the position turns desperate
it works, but the cost is real: harm, a complication, or less done
it works better than planned: more done, and something extra
desperate: the worst happens: serious harm and the plan breaks here
it goes wrong badly: serious harm, a lost chance, or a heavy complication
it works, at a serious price: harm, or a heavy complication
it works brilliantly: more done, and the position eases
